name: unconfigured
yaml:
module: system
metricsets:
  - process         # Per process metrics
  #- process_summary # Process summary
enabled: true
period: 10s
processes: ['.*']
artifactInsts:
  - instanceId: "cycf-synthetic"
    processMatchGroups:
    processList:
      - cmdline: "java -jar app.jar --server.port=8080"
        ports:
